title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. EASY TIMED CARDIO WITH FLEXIBILITY WOVEN IN. OPEN THE HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT STEP UPS AND SLOW CLIMBERS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO. SIXTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT TIMED STEP UPS AND SLOW CLIMBERS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SATURDAY EASY CARDIO DONE. HIPS OPEN. BALANCE OWNED. HEART HONEST. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: STANDING HAMSTRING REACH
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. SOFT KNEE ON ONE LEG. HINGE AT THE HIPS AND REACH TOWARD THE FRONT FOOT UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. SWITCH SIDES WITHIN THE ROUND. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT FORCE IT.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING HAMSTRING REACHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. SOFT KNEE. HINGE AND REACH. FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE HAULING IN A BLOODY FISHING NET.

exercises.name: STATIC HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: LONG HALF-KNEELING OR STANDING SPLIT STANCE. BACK KNEE SOFT OR DOWN. TUCK THE TAIL SLIGHTLY AND SHIFT FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. BREATHE. HIP OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: STATIC HIP FLEXOR STRETCHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. LONG STANCE. EASE INTO THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT FORCE IT LIKE YOU ARE WRENCHING A BLOODY STUCK HINGE.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. ONE FOOT OFF THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. LIGHT FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. EYES FORWARD. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. ONE FOOT UP. SOFT KNEE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TOPPLE LIKE A BLOODY DRUNK AT CLOSING TIME.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: EASY STEP UPS
exercises.cue: LOW STEP OR BOTTOM STAIR. STEP UP AND DOWN AT AN EASY MARCHING PACE. TALL POSTURE. SOFT LANDINGS. THIS IS YOUR EASY TIMED CARDIO. BREATHE THROUGH IT.
exercises.speakStart: EASY STEP UPS. TWO ROUNDS. FORTY SECONDS. EASY MARCHING PACE. TALL AND SMOOTH. THIS IS YOUR CARDIO. DO NOT RACE LIKE YOU ARE LATE FOR THE BLOODY BUS.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SHAKE THE LEGS. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. KNEES BENT. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT THE HIPS. HOLD A BEAT AT THE TOP. LOWER WITH CONTROL. LIGHT STRENGTH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. SQUEEZE AND LIFT. HOLD A BEAT. LOWER CLEAN. LIGHT STRENGTH. DO NOT THUMP YOUR ARSE ON THE FLOOR LIKE A BLOODY DROPPED SACK.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP BREATHING. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FLOOR OR A LOW STEP. BODY LONG. DRIVE ONE KNEE IN THEN THE OTHER AT A SLOW CONTROLLED PACE. EASY TIMED CARDIO. HIPS STEADY. NO SPRINTING.
exercises.speakStart: SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. CONTROLLED KNEE DRIVES. EASY PACE. HIPS STEADY. THIS IS YOUR FINISHING CARDIO. DO NOT SPRINT LIKE A BLOODY MADMAN.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. STAY STANDING. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
